explanation: Traverse inorder while pruning subtrees that cannot intersect the closed query interval. Emit in-range root values between their left and right results so output is sorted.
timeComplexity: O(h+k) time for height h and k returned nodes.
spaceComplexity: O(h) recursion space, plus O(k) output.
